method: torchaudio MMS_FA CTC forced alignment on Demucs htdemucs vocals vs LRCLIB lyricsfile → Enhanced LRC (ms stamps). Line-local CTC windows with wide pad; refine = median offset then ±300 ms per-word snap.

never-gonna-give-you-up_youtube_whisper.reason: YouTube file was 213.04 s vs LRCLIB master 214.0 s — wrong master. Whisper word timestamps (±100–200 ms) are also unfit for the 40 ms pass bar. Do not use that ~1.2 s offset claim.

kendrick_bdkmv_ctc_demucs.title: Bitch, Don't Kill My Vibe
kendrick_bdkmv_ctc_demucs.audio: Deezer preview of album track 73196524 (311 s master, ISRC USUM71210774); Demucs vocals; preview text-anchored at origin_ms=48000

stamp_structure.verdict: Mostly real per-word stamps (not phrase-grouped / shared timestamps). A minority of lines look evenly spaced; end-of-song dump is phrase-like. Large absolute CTC residuals → per-word snap is the right fix.

kendrick_bdkmv_ctc_demucs.interpretation: Album-duration LRCLIB word sync is hundreds of ms late vs Demucs+CTC vocals on a duration-matched Deezer preview window. Two-step refine (680 ms constant + ±300 ms snaps) cuts high-conf median abs ~768→106 ms (p90 1263→605). Still above the 40/100 bar on this dense-rap window; companion queue applies the same refine to full matching masters.

aligner_selftest_tts.note: espeak words at known onsets; CTC shows ~40 ms systematic lag (one MMS frame)

clock_audit.karaoke_time_source: AVPlayer.currentTime via accurateElapsed → KaraokeResume.chooseElapsed every TimelineView frame (~60 Hz)
clock_audit.periodic_observer: 0.5s — UI scrubbers only; karaoke does not use it
clock_audit.playback_clock_interpolator: not used for karaoke (soft-correct tolerance 450ms would lag highlights)
clock_audit.foreground_snap: scenePhase .active + willEnterForeground + TimelineView onAppear → snapToPlayerNow reads player time, clears jump-suppress, sets line/scroll with animations disabled
